Self-reference explains DRIFT - a REAL SHA superseded by the commit that wrote it. IT CANNOT EXPLAIN A SHA THAT NEVER EXISTED. Had self-reference been the whole defect, the map would have named 38f3b6d6 and been merely superseded. TWO DIFFERENT FAILURES ARE BEING COLLAPSED INTO ONE, AND THE ADOPTED REMEDY ONLY COVERS THE ONE THAT DID NOT HAPPEN.
